messages:
maya: Heads up — I'm blocked on merging the runtime bump (runtimes PR #412) because it requires a chart change in infra/helm (infra PR #667) and a tiny SDK surface tweak in sdk-js (sdk PR #191). Can SDK/console owners take a quick look? Diffs: https://git.company/runtimes/pull/412  https://git.company/infra/pull/667  https://git.company/sdk-js/pull/191
jong: @maya looking now. what's the exact SDK change that's required? do we need a breaking rename?
alaa: it's not breaking — just a header mapping. runtime added an optional header `x-rw-model` and SDK needs to set it from the high-level client when model param is present. pushed a one-line patch to sdk-js PR (lib/client/headers.ts). Needs an owner approval + changelog entry.
sam: infra/PR-667 helm-lint is failing on staging values schema. quick snippet: ```
Error: values.schema: "resources" is required
  on infra/helm/values.schema.yaml:12
```
harper: I can review SDK today but prefer a short integration smoke test (console -> sdk -> runtime) before approving. Can someone add a single e2e that calls the /generate flow with a tiny prompt and asserts 200?
maya: good call. console PR #48 also needs to import the updated SDK client signature (small diff). I can add the smoke test in console if SDK change lands first.
deploy-bot: [staging] Helm pre-check failed for release "redwood-runtime" — hook pre-install job failed. See CI logs.
jong: ok i'll pickup the helm schema fix — on it now, pushing a patch to infra PR. sam can you re-run lint after I push?
sam: will re-run once patch is in. also noticed a flake in runtime CI unrelated to this change, opened runtimes#413 to track.
alaa: SDK PR has the changelog line in /CHANGES.md and the tiny mapping; requested review from @harper and @jong.
harper: I'll run the smoke test locally after SDK is merged. If green I'll approve SDK and console. :thumbsup:
maya: timeline check — if we get infra lint fixed and SDK approved today, I can merge infra -> runtime -> console in that order and canary to staging tonight. That work for everyone?
jong: yes, aiming to have infra PR fixed in next hour.
sam: CI re-run queued.
harper: smoke test passed locally, leaving short note in sdk-js PR, approving now. :white_check_mark:
alaa: thanks! merging sdk-js once CI completes.
maya: merged infra/helm into staging (canary tag), merged runtime PR to staging as well. watching logs for 15m.\maya: all green in staging, will schedule the console merge after a quick package publish. Thanks everyone for quick turn. :tada:
maya: final note — runtime PR 412, infra PR 667, sdk-js PR 191, console PR 48 all linked and merged to staging. I'll open a post-merge checklist PR with rollback steps.
jong: nice. thanks for owning the rollout.
sam: leaving notes about the flake in runtimes#413 — follow-up item.
deploy-bot: [staging] All checks passed for release "redwood-runtime".
maya: closing this thread, will follow up in the release checklist.
